preconditions.description: The length of the string n and the number of bracket types k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= abs(t) <= k for t in map(int, s.split()))
preconditions.description: Each bracket in the string s is an integer t where 1 ≤ |t| ≤ k.
The number of queries q is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= abs(t) <= k for query in queries if query[0] == 1 and (i, t) == query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, the position i and bracket t are within valid bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 2 and (l, r) == query[1:])
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, the substring bounds l and r are within valid bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == 'Yes' if is_correct_bracket_sequence(s[l-1:r], k) else output_line == 'No' for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, the output is 'Yes' if the substring s[l..r] is a correct bracket sequence, otherwise 'No'.
